scope.notes: Base-piece behavior and directly reachable hooks are implemented. Interactions with the remaining 187 cards and special pieces are not yet parity-verified.

compatibility: Only a piece whose runtime type is the base king receives the extra rays.
The king must start the move on one of the central four squares.
The flag belongs to the protected pawn owner.
Only an attacker rendered as a queen is blocked from capturing that player's pawn.
The status is deleted before the random roll and is consumed on both success and failure.
On success the attacker is removed and the defender is restored at the attacker's original square.
A successful defender gains one capture count.
The deadline is target-owner turnsTaken plus three.
Adjacency is checked before the deadline and clears the status early at any target-owner turn end.
Only the first runtime royal king found for that color is used for the adjacency check.
A platform spawn is attempted immediately when the RULE is installed.
Candidate order follows web rows: a8 through h8 down to a1 through h1.
The random source is consumed even when the candidate list is empty.
A landing piece is added to triggeredIds before legal moves are checked and remains there when no extra move exists.
A valid extra move keeps the same turn and restricts the next action to that piece.
